builds.name: Reference: Mixed tank
builds.goal: Reference for Sejuani: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A durable initiator who combines a dash and ranged bola with Frost-stack stuns, especially alongside melee allies. Measure Frost stacks generated by actual melee allies and own attacks, then stun cooldown. W/HP damage and AP spells must be separated; do not award instant ally stacks. Health, armor/MR and close-range effects test reliable frontline contact.
testPlan: Kit question for Sejuani: Measure Frost stacks generated by actual melee allies and own attacks, then stun cooldown. W/HP damage and AP spells must be separated; do not award instant ally stacks.

Start with the early core (Matchup defense or Heartsteel only if stacking is safe) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Health, armor/MR and close-range effects test reliable frontline contact. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Sejuani charges forward, knocking enemies into the air. The charge stops after hitting an enemy champion. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Heartsteel stacks must be finite; percent-health damage and kiting punish excessive health.

The route fails Sejuani's stated kit question: Measure Frost stacks generated by actual melee allies and own attacks, then stun cooldown. W/HP damage and AP spells must be separated; do not award instant ally stacks.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: Heartsteel stacks must be finite; percent-health damage and kiting punish excessive health.
Full cost 15,700 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
The reference is a research control, not a claim of the current highest-win-rate build.
buyOrder: Matchup defense or Heartsteel only if stacking is safe. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Unending Despair, Spirit Visage, Jak'Sho, The Protean are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

kitEvidence.formula:
Sejuani throws her True Ice bola, Stunning and revealing the first enemy champion hit for [1] second and dealing [125 / 150 / 175 + (0.4) × AP] magic damage.

If the bola travels at least 25% of its range, it Stuns and reveals for [1.5] seconds instead. It then also creates an ice storm that Slows surrounding enemies by [80]% for [2] seconds. All affected enemies take [200 / 300 / 400 + (0.8) × AP] magic damage.

Sejuani becomes immune to Slows and gains [10 + (0.75) × Stat(1)[statFormula=2]] Armor and [10 + (0.75) × Stat(6)[statFormula=2]] Magic Resist after not taking damage from champions or large jungle monsters for [characterLevelInterpolation(12 → 6; raw flags preserved)] seconds.

Sejuani's first Attack against enemies she has Stunned deals an additional [0.1] max Health magic damage.

Passive: Nearby melee allied champions' Attacks apply a stack to champions and jungle monsters.

Active: Sejuani deals [55 / 105 / 155 / 205 / 255 + (0.7) × AP] magic damage to target enemy with 4 stacks and Stuns them for [1] second.

Sejuani swings her flail, dealing [5 / 15 / 25 / 35 / 45 + (0.3) × AP + (0.04) × Stat(12)] physical damage and Knocking Back minions and jungle monsters. She then lashes out again, dealing [5 / 25 / 45 / 65 / 85 + (0.6) × AP + (0.08) × Stat(12)] physical damage and briefly Slowing targets.

Both swings apply stacks of Permafrost.
Sejuani charges, dealing [90 / 140 / 190 / 240 / 290 + (0.75) × AP] magic damage to enemies and Knocking them Up for [0.5] seconds. The charge ends after hitting an enemy champion.
